definitions.gloss: cone shape; ice cream cone; traffic cone
definitions.explanation: A cone-shaped object. Covers geometric cones, the wafer cones used for ice cream, and the bright safety cones used to mark off areas on roads and construction sites.

examples.japanese: ⟦アイス→アイス：06770_aisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧コーン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate the ice cream in a cone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧コーン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Traffic cones are lined up on the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コーン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれていた→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧。
examples.english: The area under construction was surrounded by red and white traffic cones.

notes:
Loanword from English "cone." Covers several distinct objects in Japanese — geometric, edible, and safety — without distinguishing them lexically. Note: コーン also means "corn" as a separate loanword from "corn" (the grain); context usually makes which one clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦アイスクリーム→アイスクリーム：03830_aisukuriimu⟧コーン: ice cream cone
- ⟦{三角|さんかく}→三角：04177_sankaku⟧コーン: traffic cone ("triangle cone")
- ⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧コーン: colored safety cone (often used generically)
- コーン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧: cone shape

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{円錐|えんすい}→円錐：05550_ensui⟧: cone (the technical geometric term)
